Counselling for Individuals and Families

Support That Fits Your Family’s Real Life

I offer counselling, parent coaching and behavioural support for children, teens, adults and families across British Columbia — especially families living with neurodevelopmental differences, big emotions, or behaviour that feels hard to manage. Together we work to understand what may be driving the difficult moments and build strategies that hold up at home, at school and in everyday routines.

I have worked with neurodivergent children, youth and adults, including people with autism, ADHD, FASD, learning disabilities and other complex needs. Rather than only trying to stop a behaviour, I help families understand what it may be communicating, and which sensory, emotional, relational or environmental factors may be playing a part.

No two families are alike, so support is shaped around your goals, your values and your child’s unique strengths. Sessions are held securely online, so you can connect from home anywhere in the province — from Victoria and the Lower Mainland to the Okanagan and Prince George.

Meet Claire

Warm, practical counselling built around you.

I’m a Registered Clinical Counsellor (RCC) in British Columbia with a Master’s degree in Counselling Psychology and over nine years of experience supporting children, youth, adults and families in schools, community agencies and private practice.

My style is collaborative, warm and practical. I draw on evidence-based approaches such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) skills, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Motivational Interviewing (MI), and shape every session around the person in front of me rather than a fixed program.

I have particular experience with anxiety, low mood, emotional regulation, neurodiversity, developmental disabilities, parenting stress and behavioural concerns. When I’m not working, you’ll most likely find me on a North Shore trail with my dog.

Getting Started Is Simple

Three simple steps to begin counselling.

Book a Free Consultation

Start with a free 15-minute phone or video call to ask questions, talk about what’s going on, and see whether working together feels right.

Choose the Right Support

If you decide to go ahead, we’ll set clear goals together and choose the type of support — individual, youth, family or parent sessions — that suits you best.

Start Counselling

Meet with me online from home, anywhere in BC, and begin working toward the changes that matter most to you and your family.
